habitat: Primary dipterocarp forest; peatswamp forest; lowland rainforests
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Bornean Bristlehead (Pityriasis gymnocephala) stands out. This species, part of the Pityriasidae family, is a resident of Primary dipterocarp forest; peatswamp forest; lowland rainforests. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Bornean Bristlehead is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Bornean Bristlehead and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
